speaker: Daniel
text: One day, I came away from my house filled with fury because of a poor job some painters had done on my house. My friend waved to me as I walked by, so I went into his shop to vent my frustration. He let me speak angrily about the poor work and carelessness of present-day workmen. “They had no pride in their work,” I said. “They just wanted to collect money for doing nothing. The undutiful attitude these days is almost a sin.”
